messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] SOA CompAct - R Corner
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,
 
The US Society of Actuaries (SOA) has a quarterly newsletter: CompAct
<http://www.soa.org/news-and-publications/newsletters/technology/compact-det
ails.aspx> Electronic Newsletter, which from issue 29 (Oct-2008) onwards
includes a column called R Corner. The articles are written by Steve
Craighead and so far most of them have been nicely aimed at picking up
useful basic concepts for the actuarial type. However there seems to be a
tendency that articles will get more complex and specific as introductory
topics are covered -- save for issue 34 ;).
 
Here is a summary of the concepts / subjects already dealt with:
 
    - Issue 29: introduction to CRAN | demo() | help()
    - Issue 30: read.csv() | write.csv() | RODBC package
    - Issue 31: data types: vectors | matrices | data.frames | related
functions
    - Issue 32: model formula framework: formula basics | LM | GLM | I()
    - Issue 33: cluster analysis | predictive modeling
    - Issue 34: user-defined functions
 
The only drawback seems to be that, as far as I can see, there are no
subscription / RSS options. If anyone knows how to get alerted of new
issues, please share!
 
Also from Steve Craighead:
<http://www.soa.org/library/newsletters/risk-management-newsletter/2008/marc
h/rmn-2008-iss12-craighead.pdf> A Toy Copula ERM Model in R.
 
 
Regards,
Diego

	[[alternative HTML version deleted]]
